subject: Post-call: hosting & residency constraints — MedSec discovery
messages:
From: Eleanor Bates <eleanor@medsec.co>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 16:12:00 -0500
Subject: Hosting requirements discovery — MedSec (follow-up)

Thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap from our side and a few clarifying points so we can prepare for the tech deep dive: 

High-level pain / drivers:
- Data residency: PHI and clinical trial metadata must remain in our US-controlled cloud region (no egress to other regions).
- Regulatory: We need evidence of SOC 2 scope for logging/audit and KMS integration for key separation.
- Air-gap requirement for one environment (processing of deeply sensitive PII) — we expect an on-prem or isolated VPC pattern with no internet egress for that environment.
- Latency: Our internal routing expects sub-120ms median per-request for UI workflows (peak concurrency ~50 requests/min).

What we can share now (attachments): 
- medsec-compliance-snapshot.pdf — high-level compliance posture and redlines from procurement.
- network-zone-diagram.png — where we'd expect Redwood to sit (simple sketch).

Clarifying asks for the next call: 
1) Can Redwood support a private control plane with customer-managed VPC endpoints and KMS/HSM integrations?
2) What minimal network ports and CIDR ranges will your runtime require for private deployments?
3) For the air-gapped environment, do you offer an on-prem appliance or is the pattern strictly VPC-with-no-egress?
4) Can you share a short list of required evidence for SOC2 (logs, retention, access records) so our compliance team can pre-clear items?

Next steps: schedule a 60-minute technical deep dive with your infra engineer and our network/security lead (we can do Wed or Thu morning PST).

Thanks,
Eleanor Bates
Director, IT Security
MedSec Therapeutics

--

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Hosting requirements discovery — MedSec (follow-up)

Eleanor — thanks for the clear notes and for sending the attachments. Posting a concise playback of what I heard and proposed next steps so everyone has a single source of truth.

Playback (short):
- Residency: Redwood can pin customer data to a single region (US-East or US-West) and prevent cross-region replication by policy. For PHI-backed workflows we recommend Dedicated or Private deployments (customer-owned VPC / private control plane).
- KMS/HSM: We support external KMS integration (AWS KMS + custom key policies) and have an HSM-backed option for Private deployments; we'll surface the required key policies for your security team.
- Air-gap: For fully air-gapped processing we offer a packaged on-prem deployment (appliance/container bundle) OR a strict VPC deployment with firewall rules and no NAT egress; the on-prem option is required if you need zero external connectivity.
- Latency: We can hit the <120ms median for UI traffic with a combination of reserved GPU capacity and local inference endpoints; we'll validate against your payload sizes in the deep dive.

Immediate asks / info we need from MedSec before the infra deep dive (technical):
- Confirm which environment needs full air-gap vs which can be VPC-isolated (list by environment name).
- Provide an inbound/outbound network inventory (expected CIDRs, egress blocklist constraints, proxy/transit gateways).
- Share your SOC2 evidence request doc (if possible) or priority items (logs, retention windows, audit trails).
- Sample request shapes and PII/PHI fields so we can estimate tokenization/cost/latency impact.

Proposed next steps and owners: 
1) Tech deep dive — Redwood infra (Ben) + Solutions (Marissa) + MedSec Net/Sec (Eleanor + their network lead). Duration: 60–75m. Action: Ben to propose times.
2) Pre-read: MedSec to upload the SOC2/redline doc and network inventory to the drive link you shared. (Eleanor)
3) Follow-up deliverable: We'll send a short SOW template and two deployment patterns (on-prem appliance vs VPC-isolated) with estimated latency and cost delta. (Soojin)

Ben, Marissa — can you confirm availability for Wed 11/17 or Thu 11/18 morning PST?

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182
